accessibility.description: LeAccess adds screen-reader speech for menus, dialogue, inventory, crafting, skills, quests and travel, plus positional audio, wall radar and exploration beacons. Requires the Windows Steam edition and a controller using the game's default bindings. The author has tested NVDA, online and offline play, and co-op; other screen readers and SAPI fallback are untested. This public test release still has silent screens and does not convey visual attack telegraphs or ground-effect warnings. Full campaign and endgame coverage have not been established.
